extension_dataCollectionDescription.message: This add-on does not collect any user data or telemetry. All data (notes) is stored locally in the user's browser.

extension_description.message: A lightweight notepad in the browser sidebar

import_confirm.message: Import will replace all existing notes and tags. Continue?

import_error_missingNotes.message: Invalid file — expected JSON with a notes field

import_error_schemaVersion.message: This file was created by a newer version of the app and cannot be imported.

import_warning_rejected.message: Skipped $NOTES$ invalid notes and $TAGS$ invalid tags.

import_warning_truncated.message: Shortened $NOTES$ notes that exceeded the 50 KB size limit.

list_empty_lead.message: Type in the field at the top and press Enter, or open the editor straight away.

list_empty_ex_note.message: Weekend idea: a trip to the mountains

list_empty_ex_task_result.message: The ! makes it a task, here for tomorrow, 10:00

list_empty_popup.message: opens quick capture from any tab.

ob_done_s1.message: That's enough to get started. Next lesson: Quick capture — due date, priority and repeating in one line. All lessons are in settings (⚙ at the bottom), in the Guide section.

ob_done_s2.message: Quick capture done. Next lesson: Your note — formatting, blocks and links. Find it in settings (⚙), in the Guide section.

ob_done_s3.message: Formatting done. One lesson left: Focus and your data — zen mode, global shortcuts and backups.

ob_done_s4.message: Guide complete. You can replay any lesson from settings. Enjoy!

ob_s1_1.message: This is the quick capture field. Type anything, e.g. a weekend idea. Right below the field you can see what you'll get. Enter adds it.

ob_s1_2.message: Every entry lands on this list. Click yours to open it.

ob_s1_2_empty.message: The list is still empty. Go back one step (←), type something in the field above and press Enter.

ob_s1_3.message: Here you write the content, and above it you change the title. Everything saves automatically and locally, on this computer — there is no Save button. Undo a slip with Ctrl+Z.

ob_s1_4.message: An entry can be a note or a task. A task has a checkbox — create one by starting the entry with !, e.g. !client meeting.

ob_s1_convert.message: Here you turn the note into a task and back. Nothing gets lost.

ob_s2_1.message: This lesson happens in one field. Type: !!concert tickets tomorrow 9:00. Below the field you'll see what you'll get. Then press Enter.

ob_s2_dates.message: You write the due date in plain words: today, tomorrow, in 3 days, on friday or 06/15. Add a time, e.g. 14:30, and you get a reminder.

ob_s2_priority.message: Marks at the start say what the entry is: ! is a task, !! an important task, and !> a task in progress, e.g. !>client report. !!> means both.

ob_s2_recurrence.message: Repeating works with words too: daily, weekly, every tuesday. If you don't see a due date below the field, write it differently, e.g. tomorrow or 06/15.

ob_s2_shortcuts.message: You can reach the field without the mouse: Alt+C. $POPUP$ opens it in a separate window over any page.

ob_s3_1.message: Open any note from the list — you'll practise on it.

ob_s3_1_empty.message: The list is empty. Add a note in the field above (type something and press Enter), then click it on the list.

ob_s3_2.message: This bar works like in Word: select some text and click an icon, e.g. bold or a list. Alt+E hides and shows the bar.

ob_s3_3.message: Type / on an empty line — a block menu opens: task lists, code blocks, colored callouts and more.

ob_s3_4.message: Prefer the keyboard? Markdown shortcuts work: # and space make a heading, - and space a list, **text** bold. You don't need them — the bar does the same.

ob_s3_5.message: Here you can copy the whole note as Markdown and paste it into an email, a document or a chat. Shortcut: Alt+K.

ob_s3_link.message: Select some text and click this icon (or Ctrl+K) to add a link. A clicked link opens in a new tab.

ob_s4_1.message: Zen mode hides everything except today's things. Click this icon or press Alt+Z.

ob_s4_2.message: The rest dimmed, and the list shows only today's things. The same button (or Alt+Z) goes back to the normal view — try it.

ob_s4_3.message: An open note takes the whole panel and the list hides, so nothing distracts you. Open any note from the list.

ob_s4_3_empty.message: The list is empty. Add a note in the field above (type something and press Enter), then click it on the list.

ob_s4_4.message: Go back to the list with the ← arrow next to the title or the Esc key. Everything saves itself — try it now.

ob_s4_backup.message: Your notes are only on this computer, we don't send them anywhere. In settings you can make a backup (Export data). Deleted notes wait in “Recently deleted”.

ob_s4_privacy.message: Important: notes are not encrypted. Anyone with access to this browser on this computer can read them. Don't store passwords or card numbers in them.

ob_s4_settings.message: Settings are under the ⚙ icon. There you can change the look, make a copy of your notes and see all shortcuts.

ob_s4_shortcuts.message: AsideNotes works from any tab: $TOGGLE$ opens and closes this panel, and $POPUP$ opens the quick capture window.

panel_density_info.message: Comfortable gives the note toolbar buttons bigger click areas, so they are easier to hit. Compact is tighter and fits more into a narrow panel, for example when the browser takes half the screen.

panel_font_info.message: Lexend is a typeface designed for reading fluency. Wider letter spacing and more distinct letter shapes make similar characters harder to confuse. It can help with dyslexia, low vision, and eye strain during longer reading. The change applies to the whole interface — the panel and the quick add window.
